description:
R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)

R&D Engineer (Advanced Drilling Systems)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Our client is expanding its R&D team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and is seeking highly motivated engineers to contribute to the development of cutting-edge drilling technologies for offshore deepwater applications. This opportunity centers on innovation, new product development, and testing—not operations or maintenance.

We are hiring across multiple disciplines to support core technology areas including downhole power generation, coiled tubing/drillstring development, subsea and high-voltage electronics, and advanced testing/integration systems. Ideal candidates will have a solid background in research and development (R&D), system design, and engineering analysis, with hands-on experience in product development for high-reliability environments.

Areas of Expertise We’re Looking For:

  • Mechanical Engineering: Experience in drilling motors, downhole turbines, or subsea pumps for power generation; coiled tubing/drillstring development; familiarity with manufacturing, machining, and supplier coordination.
  • Mechanical Design/Drafting: Proficiency in generating manufacturing drawings for complex drilling or subsea components and coordinating with manufacturers/suppliers.
  • Integration/Test Engineering: Engineers with a mechanical or electrical/electronics focus, experienced in downhole or subsea systems, sensor integration, test equipment design, and data acquisition.

Electrical Engineering:

  • Plasma/High-Voltage Electronics: High-voltage systems for plasma-based drilling. Relevant experience in military, defense, pulsed power, lasers, or nuclear sectors is a plus.
  • Subsea/Downhole Electronics: Development of high-power electronics and embedded systems for subsea applications.

Software/Firmware/Controls Engineering:

  • Firmware Development: Development and validation of high-reliability firmware for oil & gas environments.
  • Controls Engineering: Experience with PLC programming, real-time control systems, test equipment design, and HIL testing. Familiarity with MATLAB, dSPACE, or SPEEDGOAT is advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute R&D projects in alignment with technical specifications, timelines, and budget
  • Design, test, and commercialize innovative drilling tools and systems for offshore use
  • Implement processes and tools that drive excellence and innovation in product development
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams, leadership, and suppliers to ensure successful integration and delivery
  • Manage technical risks and ensure compliance with HSEQ and regulatory standards
  • Produce detailed engineering documentation including drawings, calculations, and technical reports
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation within the R&D team
  • Represent the company’s technical work at conferences to reinforce its position as a technology leader

Our client is growing its footprint in Brazil to address the region’s unique energy challenges. With a focus on offshore and deepwater solutions, the local team is instrumental in developing next-generation drilling systems tailored to this critical market. They work in close partnership with global collaborators and local operators to bring advanced solutions to life.

In this role, you’ll engage in transformative R&D efforts alongside teams in Brazil, Europe, and the USA—contributing to innovations across both conventional and renewable energy domains.

title: Gerente Comercial de Recuperação de Carteira
description:
Horário: De segunda a sexta, das 8h às 18h
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

Vaga: Gerente Comercial de Recuperação de Carteira - Vendas Presenciais | Agro

Local de trabalho: Presencial na sede da empresa - RJ- Centro.

Objetivo da Função:

Recuperar clientes inativos, aumentar o faturamento e garantir a execução diária das metas comerciais, atuando junto com a equipe na linha de frente.

Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia (Mão na Massa):

  • Fazer ligações diárias para clientes inativos e ajudar a equipe a reverter objeções.
  • Acompanhar de perto o desempenho individual de cada vendedor, escutando áudios, analisando conversas no WhatsApp e corrigindo abordagens em tempo real.
  • Treinar a equipe diariamente em técnicas de vendas, argumentação, roteiro de abordagem e follow-up.
  • Criar, ajustar e aplicar scripts de vendas focados na recuperação de carteira.
  • Monitorar os principais indicadores (KPIs): Número de ligações/dia, taxa de reativação, ticket médio por cliente reativado.
  • Realizar reuniões rápidas diárias (Daily de Vendas) com foco em ajustes imediatos.
  • Atuar como vendedor se necessário, ajudando a fechar vendas complexas ou com clientes estratégicos.
  • Repassar feedbacks diários ao time comercial e à direção sobre resultados e ajustes necessários.

Requisitos:

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Histórico de atuação com recuperação de clientes ou vendas ativas.
  • Domínio de CRM (ex: Moskit ou outro equivalente).
  • Boa capacidade de análise de resultados (Excel ou BI simples).
  • Perfil de liderança prática (exemplo no dia a dia, não só gestão de números).

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Alta energia e resiliência para trabalhar com metas agressivas.
  • Facilidade de comunicação e argumentação.
  • Foco em resultado com disciplina diária.
  • Liderança inspiradora: motivar pelo exemplo.
  • Organização e senso de urgência.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas valorizados):

  • Experiência no setor agropecuário.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de SPIN Selling, Inside Sales ou Vendas Consultivas.
  • Vivência em gestão por OKRs ou metas SMART.

Benefícios e Remuneração:

- Salário fixo + comissão sobre vendas da equipe + bônus por metas de recuperação.

description:

Join to apply for the Senior Engineering Manager- Ubuntu role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team that delivers the essential components of Ubuntu - our system startup, compilers, language runtimes and toolchains, as well as networking and storage config and management. This is a fast-paced, problem-solving, highly technical role operating at the core of Linux server systems.
As an Engineering Manager on the Foundations team, you will be at the heart of driving Ubuntu. Working at the unique intersection of the open source ecosystem, and enterprise technologists.
In this pivotal position, you'll lead and inspire your team of engineers, to take Ubuntu to new heights. We are looking for someone with a deep understanding of Linux and Ubuntu with a passion for exceptional leadership. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery and drive your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Globally remote
The role entails

  • Lead and grow a team of distributed engineers
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles through active and hands on leadership
  • Be responsible for planning, estimation and execution
  • Work with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leadership teams
  • Drive the advancement and adoption of the latest software development practices
  • Design, embrace and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps
  • Work from home while meeting in person for company sprints. Sprints are typically twice a year for 1-2 weeks.
What we are looking for in you
  • You have worked extensively with Linux distributions, and are experienced with packaging technologies (e.g. deb, rpm, other)
  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • High quality software engineering knowledge in one or more of: Linux system architecture, boot process, Java/GCC/Python/Rust/Go toolchains, ARM and/or RISC-V
  • Engagement with open source communities and processes
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Project Manager I, Operations
description:
Project Manager I, Operations may be assigned multiple projects depending on the complexity or will oversee the execution of a phase(s) for a larger project. Responsible for all aspects of the project over the entire project life (initiate, plan, execute, control, close) to meet business objectives through the utilization of project management methodologies.This includes but is not limited to; coordinating a project team, developing a schedule, and monitoring the project process to ensure the quality and timely completion of project(s).

What You Will Do:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects
  • Develop schedules/timelines/cost plans that support the business objectives, established budgets, resources, and project deliverables for each project
  • Coordinate day-to-day execution of the overall project delivery process.
  • Assure projects are executed within the approved budget and schedule and in accordance with company Quality requirements
  • Managing risks and issues and taking corrective measurements
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports related to the project.
  • Managing stakeholders’ communication and preparing communications for management and updates.
  • Managing the main project documentation from project initiation through completion in accordance with the process instruction.
  • Ensure that invoices are properly prepared in accordance with contractual terms and are issued to clients in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and submit time charge records and expense reports in a timely manner in accordance with company procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Typically requires a minimum of 1-3 years of project management-related experience in a lead role.
  • Typically requires a Bachelor of Science and at least one year of experience in the maritime and/or offshore industry.
  • Preferably holds a Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) or a general certification in Project Management

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to effectively speak and write English fluently
  • Experience and knowledge of project management methodologies and techniques
  • Ability to work positively with a wide range of individuals involved in the project
  • The ability to identify, analyze and solve complex and unique project-related problems.
  • Ability to organize, plan, monitor, and control project contractual requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work.
  • Proficient with PM tools and software (i.e. MS Office and MS Project)
  • Possesses good communication skills both orally and in writing technical issues to personnel who may or may not be in related technical fields.
  • The desire and ability to work as a member of a team.
  • Realization of financial aspects of approved business plans and budgets pertaining to the project.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Director or Executive level position

Working Conditions:

Work is primarily sedentary; exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move object

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.
What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience:
  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
It Would Be Nice If You Have:
  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.
Reporting Relationships:
The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.

Duties and Responsibilities
Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is starting a project with the municipality of Congonhas, Minas Gerais, in cooperation with the Municipal Planning and Management Department. This project aims to revise the Master Plan and develop the city's Mobility Plan. To achieve the proposed objective, the "Horizontes Congonhas" project is designed to strengthen public capacity and promote a culture of transparent decision-making based on data and information. This will be achieved through diagnostics, analysis, training and the drafting of plans. The Master Plan and the Mobility Plan wi ll be drawn up with the participation of society, configuring them as social pacts that take into account its interpretation of the strengths, potential and challenges of the city's spaces, seeking to improve the population's quality of life. To properly implement the project, a Data Analyst is required. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Data Analyst will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a. Assist in the elaboration and calculation of variables, indicators and other data and information. b. Extract, process, and analyse data from public databases and statistics - such as those produced by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics and other organizations – and present them in various formats (tables, graphs, charts). c. Elaborate and/or support the creation of georeferenced information. d. Revise all documents produced related to spatial data and information. e. Participate and organize capacity building activities for UN-Habitat and government staff working in the implementation of UN-Habitat’s projects in Brazil. f. Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to collection, production, analysis and management of data, information and urban indicators and support any other studies and research. g. Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions. h. Provide inputs for the identification of project risks. i. Document and maintain an orderly and accessible information file related to all activities undertaken. j. Be responsible for the delivery according to deadlines for each task and conduct administrative and management activities to ensure that projects meet the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget and quality. k. Document expert group meetings, training events and other activities related to the planning, development and implementation of ongoing and new projects. l. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisors. m. Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Data Analyst will support the implementation of the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office of monthly activities’ report.
Qualifications/special Skills
Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in social sciences, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Economics, or related Fields is required. Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Policy, Sociology, Political Science, Geography, Economics, Urban Studies, Statistics, or related fields is required, or four (4) additional years of experience relevant to the position, in addition to the requirement. Work experience:
  • Minimum five (5) five years of progressively responsible experience in project/programme management on urban related themes.
  • Professional and academic experiences on themes related to data analysis, reports and information for public policy, data visualization, data collection, processing and analysis are required.
  • Professional experience in the development of Master Plans and/or Mobility Plans is desired.
  • Experience related to UN and/or any other international agency is an asset. Skills:
  • Proficiency in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, Powerpoint and Outlook) is required.
  • Proficiency in geographic information system (GIS) software such as QGIS or ArcGIS is required.
  • Good handling of software, online platforms and other tools for data visualization is desirable.
  • Good command of programming languages such as R or Python is desirable.
  • Good knowledge on project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
  • Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
  • The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
  • The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
  • The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
  • The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
  • The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
  • The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
  • The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
  • For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese and English is required. Working knowledge of Spanish is desired.

This is a general selection process for all seniority levels, to join teams that focus on open source networking software at Canonical. Apply here if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking at any level - from the Linux kernel IP or eBPF and bridge constructs, to overlay SDN networking like OVS and OVN, to router, switch and radio access technologies such as SoNIC, FRR and DENT, all the way up to telco MANO and 5G Core solutions.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimise Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data centre networking, from bare metal through virt, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
If you have a passion for networking technologies, deep familiarity with Linux networking and awareness of open source community best practices, then you will enjoy our software-defined networking role at Canonical. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, OpenStack, LXD, MAAS and MicroK8s across a broad range of devices and use cases.
These roles include:

  • Kernel Networking Software Engineer
  • OVN Software Engineer
  • SmartNIC Software Engineer
  • Top-of-Rack (ToR) Software Engineer
  • SoNIC or DENT Software Engineer
  • Telco Software Engineer
  • Kubernetes Software Engineer
Location: we have networking software engineering roles in every time zone
What your day will look like
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the latest hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software

#EssênciaPlay9
Somos um ecossistema de desenvolvimento de conteúdo e expansão de audiência para marcas e influenciadores.
Em 5 anos de história, construímos um ecossistema integrado com 3 unidades de negócio que geram soluções one-stop-shop para nossos parceiros.

  • Creators: Desenvolvimento da carreira e de soluções de conteúdo para criadores.
  • Brands: Uma content house focada em desenvolvimento criativo ponta a ponta.
  • Action: Soluções e infraestrutura interna para produções audiovisuais em qualquer formato.
Permeando todo esse ecossistema, contamos com o Playnest, nossa plataforma proprietária focada em dados e desenvolvimento da Creator Economy.
Ao longo dessa jornada, trabalhamos com marcas de diversos segmentos nacionais e internacionais, assim como parcerias exclusivas com plataformas digitais.
Dessas conexões, criamos projetos always on, milhares de campanhas, cases de sucesso e colecionamos prêmios como: Caboré na categoria Produtora do Ano (2022) e Melhor Agência de Influenciadores pelo IBest (2022 e 2024).
Mais do que isso, aqui acreditamos em ideias, propósitos & PESSOAS!
É através de um encontro multigeracional e diverso que desafiamos o óbvio com ideias e provocamos um ambiente onde pessoas possam ser quem são, unindo vivências com possibilidades únicas e que permeia autoconfiança e empoderamento no time. Portanto, quando surge um novo desafio, a gente vai lá e faz!
Acha que combina com o seu perfil? Então vêm voar ao infinito e além com a gente!
#SobreAÁrea
Sabe as famosas #publis para criadores e marcas? É o nosso time Comercial que toca esse processo por aqui. Mais do que isso, são responsáveis por trazer oportunidades de negócios, fazer negociações, ser a ponte de relacionamento e atendimento de clientes e influenciadores e claro, garantir eficiência em cada etapa.
Como Será o Seu Dia a Dia
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes.
  • Apresentar soluções de marketing de influência para grandes marcas e agências.
  • Construir e manter um pipeline robusto de oportunidades comerciais.
  • Liderar reuniões e apresentações comerciais, com foco em conversão e relacionamento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de planejamento e operações para garantir entregas de excelência.
Do Que Você Precisa

  • Acesso e relacionamento com grandes anunciantes e agências de publicidade.
  • Histórico comprovado em prospecção ativa, fechamento de novos negócios e expansão de carteira.
  • Excelente comunicação, capacidade de negociação e perfil orientado a metas.
Não é obrigatório, mas vamos curtir se você tiver:
  • Experiência prévia em agências de marketing de influência.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de creators, plataformas sociais e KPIs de campanhas de influência.

Job Title
Sr. Manager, Business Information Security Officer (BISO)
Job Description
Concentrix Corporation is seeking a Brazil Business Information Security Officer to join the Global Security team reporting to the CNX MET GEO Business Information Security Officer – Insider Risk and Compliance team.
The Brazil Business Information Security Officer (BISO) focuses on proactively identifying security and compliance issues/risks to business operation processes in various accounts, drives in executing the controls to deter, detect and mitigate security and insider risks - including establishing capability and mechanisms to monitor and audit information and data protection of both Concentrix and clients as well as compliance level of each process and relevant control item as deployed in the operational environment, The country BISO drives proactively to enhance the fraud and compliance prevention culture and risk-free environment in Concentrix as well as identifies issues that would include but not limited to physical and logical security, data privacy, KPI, CSAT, inbound/outbound calls manipulation, information leakage, etc. impacting business. Typical activities include but are not limited to Risk Management – risk identification, risk assessments, support in development of risk action plans, risk closures, supporting investigations - case documentation, written first-hand reports, involve in-person or remote interview of persons of interest and working outside normal business hours etc., Governance and metrics, Executive presentations, Collaboration with all teams/ departments. Achieves results through direct interaction as well as influencing other internal groups or persons to achieve results.
Qualifications

  • 7 to 10 years of experience working in risk and compliance management, internal security controls, internal/external security assessment or audit, internal or cyber incident investigations.
Advanced English Level is a MUST, Spanish will be a plus
  • Bachelor's/ Masters’ Degree in Information Technology or relevant areas.
  • CISA certified or willing/able to certify within 12 months of employment.
  • Experience in the BPO industry working in quality, security compliance or delivery strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of BPO Business Operation and CRM services delivery processes.
  • Understanding fraud, process non-compliance and incident investigations as well as various risks in the BPO industry.
  • Ability to identify performance and opportunity gaps.
  • Detail oriented with excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate findings to senior team members with appropriate recommendation and action plan raised to address the gaps in an effective & efficient manner.
BISO Responsibilities
  • Drive the highest Integrity and Ethical standards across the staff and the accounts in scope.
  • Provide governance to operations management team and Quality Assurance team for effective and efficient surveillance and monitoring towards pro-active security and business process non-compliance issue identification.
  • Collaborate with respective supporting functions/departments (IT, HR, Facility, Legal, DPO, etc.) to address relevant security issues/risks.
  • Perform internal audit/assessment on regular basis based on different business process compliance management and risk control mechanisms in different accounts to ensure the full compliance as per relevant standard and identify potential issues/risks.
  • Work closely with the operation team to get all identified non-compliance items fixed in a timely manner to drive for closure and proactively propose and deploy extra preventive controls where appropriate.
  • Establish and execute a robust methodology for periodic reviews aiming to highlight the gaps that exist in the operational processes.
  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, root causes of business issues, and/or opportunities.
  • Provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions and suggest improvements to the processes.
  • Review and report the results and present to management team.
  • Ensure partnership with accounts management team for Proactive Compliance Risk Management – identification, assessment, risk action planning, and closures.
  • Coordinate and support Global Security Assessments (GSAs) - a holistic assessment (technology, HR, operations, finance, etc.) of risks being faced by delivery operations and No Notice Inspections (NNIs) conducted against the specific accounts in scope.
  • Participate and involve in assigned investigations.
  • Conduct incidents analytics for assigned areas within the defined timelines.
  • Drive incidents to closure in a timely manner as required.
  • Document learnings from incidents and circulate to relevant stakeholders Work with Client Risk Control Team directly as the security SPOC from CNX.
  • Conduct employee awareness and assist in developing training materials and where necessary assist in specific training.
Accountability
  • Ensure the security and business process compliance in various accounts to meet business and client expectation.
  • Continuously improve the compliance level driven by operational requirement and business growth.
  • Partner/support the country BISO with the completion of various security programs/initiatives in the concerned accounts driven by Insider Risk and Compliance team, including but not limited to the GSA and NNI.
  • Monitor assigned areas of risk ownership ensuring closures are tracked and presented to required stakeholders.
  • Lead and manage the internal review work to achieve the efficiency, effectiveness, and timeliness.
  • Establish governance and cadence as enforced per guidelines.
  • Ensure assigned education sessions are conducted in a timely manner.

Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.


Main responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Acompanhamento de solicitações feitas, garantir alinhamento entre todas as partes envolvidas quanto à priorização das solicitações e no cumprimento das mesmas, dentro dos prazos acordados, dando sempre visibilidade do andamento às diferentes camadas existentes (desde os times até a executiva);
  • Iniciação ao time envolvido de conceitos e práticas ágeis;
  • Interface entre a frente de Agilidade e com o time onde estará alocada, garantindo o alinhamento entre a estratégia de Agilidade, com oroadmap de transição para contexto de agilidade, aplicando no time onde estará alocada;
  • Implementação de métodos ágeis em diferentes cenários;
  • Ser um agente dechanges , provocando constantemente a evolução da cultura;
  • Estimular o aprendizado de dinâmicas internas como workshops, reuniões, treinamentos;
  • Facilitar cerimônias do Scrum e / ou Kanban (diário, revisão, retrospectivas, planejamento, reabastecimento e refinamentos);
  • Acompanhar os times com olhar de melhoria de processos do dia a dia, além na comunicação com outros times do grupo;
  • Análise motivacional da equipe, resolução de conflitos, informações de feedbacks;
  • Atuação na remoção de impedimentos e remoção de POs e demais envolvidos;
  • Levantamento e acompanhamento de métricas de desempenho do tempo;
  • Garantir o melhor ambiente possível para as pessoas no projeto;
  • Garantir que todas as necessidades de tecnologia (infra, plataforma etc.) selecionadas mapeadas e que sejam providenciadas a tempo;
  • Facilitar cerimônias do planejamento trimestral junto às equipes de tecnologia e negócio (planejamento de trimestre, construção de OKRs, revisão de estratégia, entre outros).

Requirements and skills

Do que você precisa:

  • Ter como experiências coaching e mentoring de times multidisciplinares na aplicação de métodos ágeis com práticas, Kanban, Scrum e na aplicação de técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas;
  • Experiência em mediação de conflitos;
  • Capacidade de responder rapidamente às mudanças;
  • Facilitador do andamento do trabalho;
  • Ter comunicação clara e saber se comunicar entre diversas camadas executivas;
  • Ter sólidos conhecimentos e experiência na área de desenvolvimento de software para debates com o tempo.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Management 3.0;
  • Agilidade de Negócios;
  • Métricas;
  • Flight Levels.

Additional information

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo

Seguindo o compromisso de contribuir para um ambiente seguro para nossas pessoas, informamos que ter o esquema completo vacinação contra a Covid-19 é uma condição obrigatória para o trabalho na Globo, presencial ou a distância, e que o comprovante deverá ser apresentado como pré-requisito para a contratação.

title: Open rank professor in Data Science - School of Applied Mathematics at Fundação Getulio Vargas [...]
description:
The School of Applied Mathematics at Fundação Getulio Vargas (FGV EMAp ) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil , invites applications for one open-rank faculty position in Data Science to strengthen and complement our existing research activity in this area.

We are looking for established researchers (associate/full professor) or outstanding young researchers (assistant professor) who have demonstrated research and teaching expertise in Data Science. We will prioritize applicants whose research focuses on natural language processing, computer vision, reinforcement learning, network science and data mining, but we also welcome applications from other fields in Data Science.

The successful candidate is expected to develop an externally funded research programme, publish in high-impact venues, supervise research (postgraduate) students, teach at both undergraduate and graduate levels, and provide service to the department and institution. In general, teaching duties consist of two courses per year, one at Undergraduate and one at Graduate level. Peer-reviewed external funding is expected to be obtained and sustained. Industrial partnerships are also strongly encouraged.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science or a closely related discipline, at the time of the appointment. At the assistant professor level, the applicant is expected to have a compatible track of publications and strong potential for publishing in top ranked venues. At higher levels (associate or full professor) the applicant is expected to have an established line of research with a strong publication record, proven ability to attract external funding, and an established research network.

The successful candidate will also possess excellent communication and presentation skills, being capable of teaching both undergraduate and postgraduate students across our portfolio of Data Science courses. Fluence in Portuguese is desirable, but not required. However, by the end of the second year the applicant may be required to teach in Portuguese.

Start-up package

A generous package is available to provide the necessary resources for starting a successful independent research programme. These include computational infrastructure, lab space as well as postdoctoral positions and support for graduate students. There is also the possibility to apply internally for core-funded projects. During the first year, it will be possible to arrange for a reduced teaching load.

Salary and Benefits

We offer an internationally competitive salaries, higher than any similar academic institution in Brazil. Benefits include health and dental plans, support for young children’s education and private pension fund.

Application

All the application material must be in English. Applicants should send their applications to including:

  1. a cover letter describing their experience, interests, and suitability for the position;
  2. a curriculum vitae (no CV Lattes format);
  3. teaching statement;
  4. research statement;
  5. electronic version (PDF) of their best 3 publications (assistant professor) or best 5 publications (associate or full professor) in the past 5 years. Applications that do not include electronic versions of papers or with more than the required number of papers, will not be considered.

Applicants must also arrange for three reference letters to be sent by the referees in the link . Reference letters must be received before the application deadline .

To be considered at the associate or full professor level, the candidate should also include evidence of experience in directing graduate students.

The deadline for applications is May 31st, 2025.

Chimera Rocket Labs is an innovative aerospace technology company focused on the future of space exploration. With a commitment to creating cutting-edge solutions for space missions, we are seeking aData Engineer Intern to join our remote team. This is an exciting opportunity for an aspiring data engineer to gain hands-on experience working on projects that support our space technology initiatives.

Position Overview:

As aData Engineer Intern , you will work closely with our data engineering team to design, build, and optimize data pipelines, manage large datasets, and ensure the smooth processing and storage of data. This internship will provide you with valuable exposure to industry-standard tools, best practices, and real-world applications in the aerospace field. You will contribute to ensuring that data is accessible, reliable, and ready for analysis, helping to drive the success of space exploration projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines to collect, process, and store data from multiple sources.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers to understand data requirements and build robust solutions.
  • Clean and preprocess large datasets to ensure data quality and consistency.
  • Optimize data processing workflows to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Help build and manage data warehouses and data lakes to store and retrieve data efficiently.
  • Work with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) to deploy and manage data solutions.
  • Assist in implementing data integration processes that support the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data.
  • Contribute to automating data operations, reporting, and monitoring tasks.
  • Document data workflows, architectures, and processes for easy knowledge sharing.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, ensuring seamless data processing and retrieval.
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute to brainstorming and problem-solving sessions.

Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala for building data pipelines and processing data.
  • Basic knowledge of databases (e.g., SQL, NoSQL) and experience with database management.
  • Understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Hadoop) is a plus.
  • Exposure to cloud services such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure for data storage and processing is a bonus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks effectively in a remote environment.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies and grow in the field of data engineering.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with data integration and ETL processes.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker.
  • Exposure to version control systems (e.g., Git) for code management.
  • Knowledge or interest in aerospace technologies or engineering concepts.
  • Experience with data visualization tools or frameworks (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.

Why Join Chimera Rocket Labs?

  • Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools and technologies in the aerospace sector.
  • Work remotely with a team of passionate professionals who are driving the future of space exploration.
  • Competitive internship compensation and flexible work hours.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise in cloud computing, data engineering, and other emerging technologies.
  • Potential for future career opportunities within the company.

Start your journey at Chimera Rocket Labs as aData Engineer Intern and contribute to the next frontier of space exploration through cutting-edge data solutions!

A diversidade nos move para frente!

Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Queremos que todos aqui sejam reconhecidos pelo seu trabalho e que todos tenham as mesmas oportunidades. Nós somos diferentes, aceitamos, respeitamos e principalmente valorizamos isso.
Estamos prontos para crescer e assumir ainda mais desafios.

Em Assurance, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor fornecendo serviços de alta qualidade, que inspiram e promovem a confiança nos negócios e nos mercados de capitais. Com profissionais de Auditoria Externa, Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS), Serviços Forenses e Sustentabilidade (CCaSS) – apoiamos nossos clientes no gerenciamento das responsabilidades regulatórias e no suporte ao crescimento econômico sustentável a longo prazo.
#AssuranceEY
Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?
Como uma pessoa Auditor ou Auditora de TI da área de Technology Risk , você atuará com auditoria na área de sistemas, podendo realizar trabalhos de auditoria, controle interno, cybersecurity e digital data analytics. Em troca, você pode esperar aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajustados aos seus interesses e motivações. Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e estar pronto/a para construir um mundo de negócios melhor para nossas pessoas, nossos clientes e as comunidades que nos apoiam, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atender os clientes no que se refere a realização de revisões/auditorias independentes nos processos de negócio e TI;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias nos processos, mitigação de riscos, falhas na execução dos processos e riscos não cobertos;
  • Suporte à auditoria externa de sistemas.
Por que você?
Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:
  • Experiência em mapeamento de riscos de Tecnologia, Controles Gerais de TI (ITGC) e auditoria;
  • Conhecimento em ITGC, Application Controls, IA;
  • Graduação em Ciências da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou cursos correlatos;
  • Desejável COBIT e ITIL e conhecimento de ISAE 3402;
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol intermediário.
O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .
Quem somos
Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.
Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.
Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

title: Engenheiro Eletricista
description:
Sobre a empresa:

Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso.
Liderança. Confiança. Expertise.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Sobre a vaga:

  • Fazer projetos de instalações elétricas industriais de iluminação, aterramento, SPDA, distribuição de potência BT/AT compreendendo: elaboração e/ou supervisão da elaboração de desenhos (plantas, seções, detalhes) e listas de materiais;
  • Elaborar especificações técnicas, memórias de cálculo, diagramas, quadros de carga, etc;
  • Nomas ABNT e internacionais;
  • Familiaridade com materiais para instalações elétricas disponíveis no mercado.

Requisitos:

Formação: Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica.

Conhecimentos: Pacote Office, AutoCad , Revit (desejável), DIALux (desejável).

A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos, e você terá a oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

  • O espírito de equipe é nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção.

description:

Join to apply for the Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.
Location : we have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.
What you will focus on

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • You have worked on open source virt or container tech
  • You have experience working in the kernel or very low level system
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills We Value
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description Summary:

The LATAM Marketplace Performance Senior Manager will serve as the strategic lead for consolidating and interpreting marketplace performance data across the LATAM Operating Unit.

What You’ll Do for Us:

  • This role will leverage diverse data sources—including retail audits (e.g., Nielsen, Global Data, Meiko), home panels (e.g., Kantar), and other syndicated marketplace measurement tools—to generate actionable insights that explain market share performance.
  • Identify and interpret marketplace trends, competitive shifts, and brand performance drivers to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Act as a strategic partner to the Competitive Insights team, helping to prioritize and conduct deep-dive competitor analyses.
  • Proactively identify performance gaps and opportunities by analyzing data from syndicated sources and internal commercial intelligence.
  • Partner with the global teams to monitor monthly trends, flag deviations, and ensure consistency and accuracy across all marketplace data sources.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, strategy, category management, or consumer insights, preferably in the FMCG or beverage industry.
  • Strong experience working with syndicated data sources such as Nielsen, Kantar, and Global Data.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn complex data into business narratives and recommendations.
  • Proven experience in cross-functional collaboration across geographies and teams.
  • Excellent storytelling, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.

What We Can Do For You:

  • Iconic & Innovative Brands: Our portfolio includes over 250 products, such as Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Powerade, and more!
  • Expansive & Diverse Customers: We work with a diversified group of customers, including retail & grocery outlets, theme parks, movie theatres, and restaurants.
  • Purpose Driven: Our purpose-driven approach empowers our people to protect the environment and communities while delivering safe & quality products.
  • Global Connections: Develop, enhance, and maintain global connections to learn and move faster.
  • Community of Belonging: We foster an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their best selves to work.

Skills:

  • Data Analysis, Data Science, Executive Influence, Influencing Skills, Negotiation, Prioritization, Problem Solving, Retail Measurement Services, Stakeholder Management, Storytelling.

Additional Skills: Business Analytics, Business Insights, Customer Insights, Data Analytics, Data Mining, Data Research, Industry Knowledge

Our Purpose and Growth Culture:

We are committed to an inclusive culture grounded in our purpose to refresh the world and make a difference. We embrace a growth mindset, continuous learning, and four key behaviors: curiosity, empowerment, inclusiveness, and agility. Our culture is a key reason for our long-term success. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how to embody them in your next role at Coca-Cola.

description:
Será responsável por liderar o planejamento, a execução e o monitoramento de projetos estratégicos, além de gerenciar o backlog da sustentação do produto e o roadmap com a visão do produto. Atuando como principal ponto de contato entre stakeholders, clientes e a equipe de desenvolvimento, esse profissional assegura que o projeto/produto esteja alinhado com os objetivos de negócio e as necessidades dos clientes. Ele lidera tanto o time multifuncional do projeto cobrindo stakeholders e clientes, tanto quanto a equipe de desenvolvimento, priorizando funcionalidades para maximizar o valor do produto.

  • Definição e Comunicação da Visão do Produto: Estabelecer uma visão clara do produto e comunicar essa visão para a equipe de desenvolvimento e demais stakeholders, garantindo o alinhamento com as metas estratégicas da empresa.
  • Gestão de Backlog e Roadmap com Priorização de Funcionalidades: Manter e priorizar o backlog do produto, definindo funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, viabilidade técnica e necessidades dos usuários.
  • Planejamento e Execução de Projetos: Elaborar cronogramas, alocar recursos e desenvolver planos detalhados para que o projeto seja executado conforme o escopo e dentro do prazo e orçamento definidos.
  • Gerenciamento de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com Clientes: Manter uma comunicação clara e contínua com clientes, fornecedores e equipes internas para garantir que expectativas e requisitos sejam compreendidos e atendidos.
  • Liderança de Equipe: Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, promovendo a colaboração e assegurando que todos os membros estejam alinhados com os objetivos do projeto e do produto.
  • Acompanhamento de Progresso e Qualidade: Monitorar o progresso do projeto e o desenvolvimento do produto, identificando e resolvendo obstáculos para manter a qualidade e o valor das entregas.
  • Definição de Critérios de Aceitação: Estabelecer critérios de aceitação para funcionalidades do produto, garantindo que atendam aos requisitos de qualidade e objetivos de negócios.
  • Gerenciamento de Riscos e Contingências: Identificar, mitigar e gerenciar riscos ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto e desenvolvimento do produto, adotando planos de contingência quando necessário.
  • Análise e Melhorias Baseadas em Dados: Analisar métricas de desempenho e feedback de usuários para orientar decisões e implementar melhorias no produto e nos processos do projeto.
  • Documentação e Relatórios: Preparar relatórios de status, KPIs e marcos atingidos para a alta gestão e stakeholders, oferecendo transparência sobre o progresso do projeto e a evolução do produto.

description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

11

The Role : The Gen/AI Integration Specialist at S&P Global plays a crucial role in integrating Gen/AI within content creation processes. This role collaborates tightly with content teams to analyze opportunities for AI application, guides the creation of effective prompts, and supports content creators as they transition into an AI-centric workflow. The role also focuses on promoting the use of GenAI and automation tools, within the business workflows and provides training and support on AI and GenAI capabilities for existing and new platforms and services.

The Team:

You will join a highly motivated team scaling innovation and building platforms for our Commodity Insight business lines including news, pricing, research and analytics. We use Agile methodologies to drive ongoing delivery work closely with business and technology partners to share knowledge, embrace change and implement best-of-breed technology.

Responsibilities and Impact:

This role understands in a deep way how the new Gen/AI technologies can be applied to create content, automate workflows, and improve data analysis. This vision, combined with the knowledge of the content creator's internal processes and a desire to create seamless, integrated, efficient and high-value workflows for the business, will drive successful implementation of the new generation of content analysis and creation tools.

  • Collaborate with content creators to identify and implement GenAI solutions, including writing of effective prompts and engaging GenAI to optimize content generation. This may potentially include developing complex prompts to enhance content quality and extract data to feed databases.

  • Champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the company, including to senior leadership, with a focus on positive storytelling.

  • Analyze and optimize key processes by understanding user needs and issues to design efficient and effective business workflows

  • Model and encourage change management practices so that business teams are actively engaged in change, adopt new solutions or ways of working and improve the probability of a successful transition.

  • Lead application training sessions and facilitate additional enterprise Gen/AI trainings to impacted groups.

  • Create relevant, simply and concise training content and process documents that helps colleagues understand changes, tells a compelling story and enables effective sharing of information.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in crafting prompts for generative AI, with a portfolio of examples ranging from simple to complex scenarios

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, computer science, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

  • Strong understanding of natural language processing (NLP) and its application in creating effective AI prompts.

  • Proficiency in a scripting language like Python to facilitate prompt development and testing.

  • Proficient in training and change management to foster technology adoption.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

  • Proficiency in the English language, writing and speaking.

  • Ability to translate technical AI concepts into practical applications for non-technical teams.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with data analysis and AI-driven problem-solving techniques

  • Familiarity with LEAN Six Sigma principles

  • Experience in change initiatives

  • Experience in content creation activities - researching, reporting and content analysis

Right to Work Requirements:

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States / Brazil.
